title: College Lecture Notes
description: Structured study notes built from lecture or reading material: the key concepts, a detailed explanation of each, and a short revision summary at the end.

sections.title: Key Concepts
sections.content_description: A core term, concept, or definition being introduced -- what something IS or MEANS.
sections.instructions: List each distinct concept, term, or definition found in the material, one per line. Use only the terms and definitions present in the findings -- do not add a concept the material does not mention.

sections.title: Detailed Notes
sections.content_description: How something works: the mechanism, process, or supporting detail behind a concept.
sections.instructions: Expand on each concept with its supporting detail from the material, in the order the material gives it. Use only what the findings state -- do not add an example or explanation not present there.

sections.title: Quick Revision Summary
sections.content_description: A short summary, formula, or overall takeaway condensing the material for quick review.
sections.instructions: Condense the material above into short, exam-ready revision points. Use only facts already stated in the findings -- this section restates, it does not introduce anything new.
